scope: Verify the CLI strict default, explicit partial-read publication and DXF readback on locally authored AC1021 and AC1027 DWGs, each with one rejected entity frame followed by one valid entity.

control.sourceProfile: AC1021 and AC1027; each generated from scratch by ReadOutcomeControl(kind=1), which writes a non-finite LINE followed by a valid LINE

cases.policy: strict default on each source revision
cases.expect: the DWG operation returns success with entityParseFailures=1 and failed=1; strict export exits 1 and preserves a destination sentinel
warning states possible omissions and strict owner checks; conversion exits 0 and publishes same-revision ASCII DXF containing the one valid LINE
published DXF reopens through dwg2dxf with exactly one LINE; source and first output remain unchanged

validation.test: PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --partial-read-only (6 controls); PASS: python3 -B tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py --converter $PWD/build-gcc/dwg2dxf/dwg2dxf --writer $PWD/build-gcc/libdxfrw_dwg_local_roundtrip --fast-only (103 option controls, 47 batch controls, 2 read-observation controls, 6 partial-read controls, 4 source-disposition controls)

limits: These controls cover one generated entity parse failure at AC1021 and AC1027, the strict/partial switch, and returned LINE readback. They do not qualify other failure patterns or versions, repair/skip projections, or owner/reference failures as partial-output eligible.
